extraction_notes: Heading 7301 sheet piling — interlocking sections driven into ground for retaining walls/cofferdams. Structural support role.
7301.20 covers angles/shapes/sections welded; slotted angles common for adjustable shelving/racking frames.
Residual 'Other' under 7301.20 — welded angles/shapes/sections not specifically slotted.
Head-hardened rail — induction or flame-hardened rail head for high wear resistance on heavy-haul lines.
Asymmetric profile rail with forged ends — specialised crane/heavy-vehicle rail.
Asymmetric profile rail without end forging.
Symmetric standard rail (not asymmetric, not head-hardened) — the typical mainline rail.
Residual railway rail under 7302.10.
Tramway rail — typically grooved/girder profile embedded in pavement.
Residual rails under 7302.10 (catch-all).
Track switchgear components: switch blades, frogs (crossings), point rods — turnout assemblies.
Fish-plates bolt rail ends together; sole-plates sit under rails on sleepers.
Material specifically for joining/fixing rails — includes bolts, clips, chair-plates per 7302 chapeau (excluding fish-plates which sit in 7302.40).
Catch-all other railway construction material: cross-ties/sleepers, bedplates, chairs, chair wedges.
7303 = cast iron tubes/pipes specifically (vs 7304-7306 = iron/steel). Rainwater downpipe.
Cast iron soil pipe — building drainage waste/sewer stack.
Spun pipe = centrifugally-cast cast iron pipe — typically ductile-iron water main.
Residual cast iron pipe — other than rainwater/soil/spun.
7304.11 = stainless steel seamless line pipe for oil/gas pipelines.
Hollow blanks intended for further drawing/finishing into line pipe.
Residual stainless seamless line pipe (other than the two prior breakouts).
7304.19 = other seamless line pipe (non-stainless) — typically carbon/alloy steel API 5L grades.
Hollow blanks intended for further drawing/finishing.
Residual non-stainless seamless line pipe.
Stainless drill pipe — OCTG class. Used in oil/gas well drill string.
7304.23 = other (non-stainless) seamless OCTG drill pipe; .10 = of iron (low-carbon).
Stainless casing/tubing OCTG (production tubing or well casing).
7304.29 = other (non-stainless) seamless OCTG casing/tubing; .10 = iron.
Other carbon/alloy steel seamless OCTG casing/tubing.
7304.31 = non-stainless circular cross-section seamless, cold-drawn/cold-reduced. .11 inherits up-to-114.3mm grouping; of iron.
Steel (non-iron) cold-drawn seamless, OD up to 114.3mm.
Cold-drawn seamless tube, iron, 114.3-219.1 mm OD band.
Cold-drawn seamless tube, steel (non-iron), mid-diameter band.
Large-bore cold-drawn seamless tube, iron.
Large-bore cold-drawn seamless tube, steel (non-iron).
7304.39 = other (not cold-drawn) circular seamless tube — hot-finished. Of iron, small OD.
Hot-finished seamless, steel (non-iron), small OD.
Hot-finished seamless, iron, mid-diameter band.
Hot-finished seamless, steel (non-iron), mid-diameter band.
Hot-finished seamless, iron, large OD.
Hot-finished seamless, steel (non-iron), large OD.
7304.41 = stainless circular seamless cold-drawn — process/instrument tubing.
Stainless circular seamless, hot-finished (not cold-drawn).
7304.51 = other alloy steel (non-stainless) circular seamless cold-drawn. Boiler/high-pressure tubes.
Alloy steel cold-drawn seamless, mid-diameter band.
Alloy steel cold-drawn seamless, large OD.
7304.59 = alloy steel circular seamless hot-finished, small OD.
Alloy steel hot-finished seamless, mid-diameter band.
Alloy steel hot-finished seamless, large OD.
Other seamless tube — typically non-circular cross-section (square, rectangular, oval).
7305 = welded tubes OD >406.4mm. .11 = longitudinally submerged-arc welded line pipe for oil/gas. .11.11 = galvanised iron.
Galvanised SAW longitudinal line pipe, steel (non-iron).
Non-galvanised SAW longitudinal line pipe, iron.
Non-galvanised SAW longitudinal line pipe, steel.
7305.12 = other longitudinally welded line pipe (e.g., ERW/HFI). Galvanised iron.
Galvanised other-longitudinally-welded line pipe, steel.
Non-galvanised other-longitudinally-welded line pipe, iron.
Non-galvanised other-longitudinally-welded line pipe, steel.
7305.19 = other line pipe (e.g., spiral-welded). Galvanised iron.
Galvanised spiral-welded line pipe, steel.
Black (uncoated) spiral-welded line pipe, iron.
Black spiral-welded line pipe, steel.
7305.20 = welded casing used in drilling for oil/gas (large OD). Of iron.
Welded large-bore well casing, steel.
7305.31 = other longitudinally welded tube (not line/casing) — general structural/water. Of iron.
Longitudinally welded other tube, steel (non-iron).
7305.39 = other welded (typically spiral). Of iron.
Spiral-welded other tube, steel.
Hydroelectric penstock — high-pressure water conduit feeding turbines.
ERW = Electric Resistance Welded precision tube, iron.
ERW precision tube, steel.
Residual welded large-OD tube under 7305.90; of iron.
Residual welded large-OD tube under 7305.90; steel.
7306 = other welded tubes (smaller OD than 7305). 7306.11 = welded stainless line pipe.
7306.19 = other non-stainless welded line pipe. Galvanised iron.
Galvanised welded line pipe, steel.
Non-galvanised welded line pipe, iron.
Non-galvanised welded line pipe, steel.
Welded stainless casing/tubing OCTG.
7306.29 = other non-stainless welded casing/tubing; of iron.
Welded OCTG casing/tubing, steel.
7306.30 = other welded circular cross-section, iron/non-alloy steel. .10 = of iron.
Welded circular non-stainless tube, steel.
Welded stainless circular tube, general industrial.
Welded other-alloy steel circular tube — typically high-pressure/boiler.
Square/rectangular hollow section (RHS/SHS) — structural steel tubing.
Other non-circular hollow section (oval/triangular/special profile).
ERW precision tube under 7306.90, of iron.
ERW precision tube under 7306.90, steel.
Residual welded tube under 7306.90 — NB: input file mislabels this as 'ERW precision tubes ---- Other' but description is just 'Other' for the basket position.
7307.11 = non-malleable cast iron fittings. .10 = sponge iron cast fittings (DRI-based).
SG iron = spheroidal graphite (ductile) iron cast fittings — water mains.
Residual non-malleable cast iron fittings.
7307.19 = cast fittings other — typically malleable cast iron threaded fittings (elbows, tees, sockets).
Stainless steel flanges (RF/WN/SO etc) per ASME B16.5/B16.47.
Threaded stainless elbows/bends/sleeves.
Butt-welding fittings (elbows, tees, reducers) per ASME B16.9 — stainless.
Residual stainless fittings — couplings, unions, plugs.
7307.91 = non-stainless flanges. Galvanised carbon steel/iron.
Non-galvanised non-stainless flanges.
7307.92 = non-stainless threaded elbows/bends/sleeves. Galvanised.
Non-galvanised threaded elbows/bends/sleeves.
7307.93 = non-stainless butt-welding fittings. Galvanised.
Non-galvanised butt-welding fittings.
7307.99 = residual non-stainless fittings — couplings/unions/plugs/sockets. Galvanised.
Non-galvanised residual non-stainless fittings.
7308.10 = bridges/bridge sections. .10 = portable bridge (e.g., Bailey bridge).
Other bridges/bridge sections (permanent fixed bridges).
Steel power/electric transmission tower — angle-section lattice or tubular.
Other towers (telecom, water, observation, etc.).
Lattice mast — guyed/self-supporting truss mast.
Doors, windows, frames and thresholds — fabricated building joinery in iron/steel.
Equipment for scaffolding/shuttering/propping/pit-propping — re-usable construction temporary works.
Beams/channels/pillars/girders PREPARED for use in structures — distinct from plain rolled sections in Ch.72.
Drop rods — vertical hanger rods supporting suspended ceilings/ducts/pipes.
Hatchways, rails, bulkheads, parts of hull — ship structural components (excluding the hull itself which is Ch.89).
Galvanised steel tension bars — bracing/post-tensioning elements.
Structures and superstructures for mining — headframes, gantries, pit superstructures.
Truss rods — tension members in trusses.
Tubular steel poles for power/distribution lines.
Residual catch-all other structures and parts under 7308.90.
7309 = reservoirs/tanks >300 L (not mechanical/thermal equipment). GI tanks — galvanised iron water tanks.
GI barrels/drums (>300 L) — large galvanised iron drums.
Pressed steel tanks — bolted sectional water tanks made from pressed steel panels.
Pressure vessels — non-compressed-gas storage (cf. 7311 for gas cylinders).
Residual large >300L containers under 7309.
7310.10 = containers 50-300 L capacity. .10 = tin-plate containers.
Steel trunks/cases (mid-size 50-300 L) — luggage trunks and storage cases.
Residual mid-size containers under 7310.10 — typically 200 L steel drums (oil drums).
7310.21 = cans <50 L to be closed by soldering/crimping (food cans). .10 = tin-plate.
Residual cans under 7310.21 (non-tin-plate).
7310.29 = other small containers (not closed by soldering/crimping). .20 = trunks/cases.
Residual small containers — buckets, pails, miscellaneous storage cans.
7311 = containers for compressed/liquefied gas. .10 = LPG cylinder.
Low-pressure gas cylinder (<=35.2 kg/cm²), non-LPG.
High-pressure seamless gas cylinder (>35.2 kg/cm²) — typically industrial gas (O2, N2, Ar, H2).
Residual gas containers under 7311.
7312 = stranded wire/ropes/cables. Black (ungalvanised) wire rope.
Galvanised wire rope — marine/outdoor applications.
Stranded wire (not a 'rope' per se) — e.g., PC strand for prestressing or ACSR steel core.
Residual stranded wire/rope under 7312.10.
7312.90 = plaited bands, slings — heading 7312 covers stranded wire/ropes/cables/plaited bands/slings, NOT electrically insulated.
7313 = barbed wire and twisted fencing wire. .10 = standard barbed wire.
Twisted hoop or single flat wire and loosely twisted double wire (for fencing).
7314 = wire cloth/grill/netting. 7314.12 = endless bands for machinery, stainless (e.g., paper-making mesh belts).
7314.14 = other woven cloth of stainless steel. .10 = wire gauze/cloth/mesh.
Residual stainless woven cloth under 7314.14.
7314.19 = other woven cloth, non-stainless. .10 = wire gauze/cloth/mesh.
Residual non-stainless woven cloth under 7314.19.
7314.20 = welded grill/netting/fencing, cross-section >=3mm with mesh size >=100 cm² (large mesh).
Residual welded large-mesh under 7314.20.
7314.31 = other welded-intersection grill/netting/fencing, galvanised.
7314.39 = other welded grill/netting/fencing — non-galvanised.
7314.41 = other grill/netting/fencing, plated/coated with zinc (chicken wire, hex netting).
Residual zinc-coated mesh under 7314.41.
7314.42 = coated with plastics. .10 = wire netting (PVC-coated chain-link/chicken wire).
Residual plastics-coated mesh under 7314.42.
7314.49 = other mesh (uncoated, not welded). .10 = wire netting.
Residual uncoated unwelded mesh under 7314.49.
Expanded metal — made by slitting and stretching sheet, distinct from wire mesh.
7315.11 = roller chain (industrial standard drive chain, e.g., ISO 606).
7315.12 = other articulated link chain. .10 = lifting/hoisting chain (Grade 80/100).
Ship chain — used for mooring/towing (NB: typically anchor chains are stud-link sub-7315.81; this likely refers to other ship-board chain).
Residual articulated chain under 7315.12.
Parts of articulated link chain — connecting links, pins, side plates.
Skid (anti-skid/snow) chains for tires.
Stud-link chain — heavy marine anchor chain with stud bracing each link.
Welded link chain (non-stud) — common industrial/marine chain.
Other non-articulated chain — twisted link, jack chain, decorative.
Parts of chain (other than articulated) — hooks, shackles, swivels, master links sold for chain assemblies.
Heading 7316 = anchors, grapnels and parts.
Parts of anchors/grapnels — shanks, flukes, crowns, stocks.
Heading 7317 = nails/tacks/staples (non-threaded) of iron/steel. .11 = horseshoe nails.
Nails for fixing heel strips/toe plates — specialised cobbler/shoe nails.
Wire nails — common round/box nails drawn from steel wire.
Residual nails — masonry nails, cut nails, specialised types.
Dog spikes — large rail-fastening spikes driven into wooden sleepers.
Other spikes — boat spikes, timber spikes.
Tacks — small short-shank fasteners (carpet tacks, upholstery tacks).
Loose staples (not in strips) and drawing pins (thumb tacks). NB: staples in strips/8305 → office; staples in 8305 only for office machines.
Catch-all other nails/tacks/staples under 7317.
7318.11 = coach screws. NB: input lists 'machine screws' here but heading 7318.11 = coach screws (heavy wood screws with hex head). Treating per description.
Residual coach screws under 7318.11.
Other wood screws (tapered point, slotted/Phillips head, single-thread).
Screw hooks (cup hooks) and screw rings (eye screws).
Self-tapping screws — form mating thread as they're driven (sheet-metal/drywall/etc).
Other screws and bolts (hex bolts/cap screws/socket head) whether or not with nuts/washers — the catch-all 'industrial fastener' line.
Nuts — hex nuts, lock nuts, nylock, castle nuts.
Residual threaded fasteners — studs, threaded rods, U-bolts.
Spring/lock washers — split, toothed, Belleville washers.
Other washers — plain flat washers.
Rivets — solid, blind/pop, tubular.
Cotter pins (split pins) and cotters — retain castellated nuts/clevis pins.
Circlips — internal/external retaining rings (DIN 471/472).
Residual non-threaded fasteners — clevis pins, dowel pins, taper pins, keys.
Heading 7319 = sewing/knitting/embroidery needles, safety pins. 7319.40 = safety pins and other pins. .10 = safety pins.
Other pins — straight pins/dress pins/T-pins (not drawing-pins which are 7317).
Other articles under 7319 — hand sewing/darning needles, knitting needles, crochet hooks, bodkins.
7320 = springs of iron/steel. 7320.10 = leaf springs and leaves. .11 = motor vehicle leaf springs.
Leaf springs for railway/tramway rolling stock.
Other leaf springs (not automotive/railway).
Individual leaves for leaf-spring assemblies — spare parts.
Helical springs — compression, extension, torsion.
Coil springs for railway/tramway rolling stock.
Spring pins — slotted/coiled tension pins (roll pins).
Residual springs under 7320.90 — disc/Belleville stacks, clock springs, flat spiral.
7321 = non-electric domestic cooking/heating appliances. 7321.11 = cooking appliances/plate warmers for gas or gas+other fuels. .10 = cookers/kitchen stoves.
Other gas-fuel stoves under 7321.11.
Residual gas-fuel cooking appliances — plate warmers, hot-plates.
7321.12 = cooking appliances for liquid fuel (kerosene/paraffin stoves). .10 = cookers/kitchen stoves.
Other liquid-fuel stoves under 7321.12.
Residual liquid-fuel cooking appliances.
7321.19 = cooking appliances for other fuels (typically solid fuel — wood/coal/charcoal). .10 = cookers/kitchen stoves.
Other solid-fuel stoves and appliances.
7321.81 = other (non-cooking) domestic appliances for gas fuel — room heaters, water heaters.
7321.82 = other domestic appliances for liquid fuel — kerosene room heaters.
Clay tandoor with iron/steel body and earthen grate — Indian-specific tariff line. Essential character = iron body (per chapeau).
Other solid-fuel/other-fuel domestic non-cooking appliances.
Parts for 7321 appliances — burners, grates, doors.
7322 = non-electrically-heated radiators/heaters. 7322.11 = radiators of cast iron.
7322.19 = radiators of steel (panel/column types).
Non-electric air heaters and hot air distributors (must have built-in motorised fan/blower per heading text).
Parts of air heaters / hot air distributors.
7323 = table/kitchen/household articles. 7323.91 = of cast iron, not enamelled. .10 = pans (skillets, frying pans).
Residual cast-iron, not enamelled — pots, casseroles, griddles, kadhais.
Cast iron, enamelled — Dutch ovens, enamel-coated cookware.
7323.93 = of stainless steel. .10 = pressure cookers (Indian household staple).
Other stainless steel household — pots, pans, tiffin boxes, plates, glasses.
7323.94 = iron (other than cast iron) or steel, enamelled. Ghamella = Indian-specific shallow basin for carrying construction materials.
Enamelled steel utensils — plates, bowls, mugs (enamelware).
Residual enamelled steel household goods.
7323.99 = other (not stainless, not enamelled). .10 = utensils of galvanised iron — buckets, tubs.
Other utensils — non-coated iron/steel kitchen articles.
Residual catch-all household articles under 7323.99.
7324 = sanitary ware of iron/steel. 7324.10 = sinks/wash basins of stainless steel.
7324.21 = baths of cast iron, whether or not enamelled.
Other baths (pressed steel etc.) under 7324.29.
Other sanitary ware and parts — toilets, urinals, soap dishes, hospital sanitary fittings.
7325 = other cast articles of iron/steel. 7325.10 = of non-malleable (grey) cast iron — manhole covers, weights, counterweights.
7325.91 = grinding balls and similar articles for mills (cast iron/steel).
7325.99 = other cast articles. .10 = of iron — malleable iron castings.
Cast articles of alloy steel — wear parts, manganese-steel components.
Stainless steel castings — pump/valve bodies, etc.
Cast rudders for ships/boats.
Cast drain covers (manhole covers, gully gratings).
Cast plates and frames for sewage/water systems.
Catch-all other cast articles of iron/steel.
7326 = other articles iron/steel NES. 7326.11 = forged/stamped grinding balls (not further worked).
Forged/stamped articles for automobiles/earth-moving equipment (not further worked).
Other forged/stamped articles, not further worked.
7326.20 = articles of iron/steel wire. .10 = tyre bead wire rings for cycle/cycle-rickshaw tyres (Indian-specific concessional line).
Other articles of iron/steel wire — paper clips, hooks, baskets, wire forms.
Belt lacing of steel — wire/strip used to join conveyor belt ends.
Belt fasteners for machinery belts.
Drain covers/plates/frames for sewage/water systems — non-cast (fabricated). Parallel to cast version at 7325.99.92-93.
Enamelled iron ware (residual industrial — not household, which sits in 7323.94).
Finished grinding media balls and cylpebs (cylindrical pebbles) — further worked beyond 7326.11.
Manufactures of stainless steel NES — catch-all stainless articles not classified elsewhere.
Articles of clad metal (e.g., stainless-clad carbon steel pipes/forgings finished as articles).
Parts of ships/floating structures/vessels EXCLUDING hull/propellers/paddle-wheels (those go to Ch.89).
Shanks — shaft/stem components (e.g., footwear shanks).
Ultimate catch-all 'other' under 7326 — articles of iron/steel not classified anywhere else.
